title: JNI
description: Java Native Interface: the verbose but universal Java-to-C bridge. Bridges Java <-> C/C++ via JNIEnv calls; call overhead: moderate.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: JNA
description: Java Native Access calls C libraries without writing any JNI glue. Bridges Java <-> C via libffi dynamic; call overhead: higher (dynamic).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: P/Invoke
description: .NET’s DllImport calling native exports with marshaling attributes. Bridges .NET <-> C via DllImport marshaling; call overhead: low-moderate.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: libffi
description: The Foreign Function Interface library behind Python ctypes, Ruby fiddle, and JNA. Bridges any <-> C via dynamic call frames; call overhead: moderate.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Cython
description: Write C-speed extensions in Python-like syntax compiled to C. Bridges Python <-> C via compiled extensions; call overhead: near zero.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: PyO3
description: Rust bindings for Python with ergonomic macros and GIL handling. Bridges Python <-> Rust via extension modules; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: pybind11
description: Header-only C++11 bindings for Python with elegant type casters. Bridges Python <-> C++ via extension modules; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: SWIG
description: Wraps C/C++ for dozens of languages from interface files. Bridges C/C++ -> many via generated wrappers; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: wasm-bindgen
description: Rust<->JavaScript bindings for WASM with wasm-pack publishing. Bridges Rust <-> JS (WASM) via generated shims; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: N-API
description: Node’s ABI-stable C API for native addons surviving V8 upgrades. Bridges Node <-> C/C++ via stable ABI; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: GraalVM Polyglot
description: Run JS, Python, Ruby, R on the JVM sharing objects with near-zero cost. Bridges JVM langs <-> each other via Truffle interop; call overhead: near zero.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: cbindgen/bindgen
description: Generate C headers from Rust and Rust bindings from C automatically. Bridges Rust <-> C via generated bindings; call overhead: zero.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: COM interop
description: Windows’ Component Object Model bridging languages via vtables. Bridges many <-> many (Windows) via vtable interfaces; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: D-Bus
description: IPC message bus bridging processes and languages on Linux desktops. Bridges any <-> any (IPC) via message bus; call overhead: IPC-level.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: JEP (Java embedded Python)
description: Embed CPython inside Java with shared interpreters. Bridges Java <-> Python via embedded interpreter; call overhead: low.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
